[Model] Nemotron-3.5-Transcribe: pack the audio tower's valid frames for MMEncoderAttention (#64944)

Signed-off-by: Dongji Gao <dongjig@nvidia.com>
Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>
Co-authored-by: vllm-agent <claw@inferact.ai>

files.patch:
@@ -776,6 +776,13 @@ Speech2Text models trained specifically for Automatic Speech Recognition.
     changes it), and `/v1/audio/transcriptions` splits longer audio into pieces of at most one hour, shorter
     when `--max-model-len` is below 65,536.
 
+    Audio tower: the FP8 and NVFP4 checkpoints quantize the linear layers of its ASR encoder to FP8 through
+    their `quantization_config`. FP8 encoder attention (`--mm-encoder-attn-dtype fp8`) is not supported and
+    raises an error when the model is built. The tower attends through vLLM's multimodal encoder attention
+    backend (FlashAttention on CUDA GPUs that support it; `--mm-encoder-attn-backend` selects another). In
+    bfloat16, its output can depend on that backend and on the other clips in the batch: small rounding
+    differences can flip the thresholded speaker features on some frames.
+
 !!! note
     `VoxtralForConditionalGeneration` requires `mistral-common[audio]` to be installed.

+def test_encoder_packs_each_rows_valid_frames(tiny_tower):
+    encoder = tiny_tower.encoder.asr_encoder
+    packed = encoder.pack(torch.tensor([2, 0, 3]), 4, torch.device("cpu"))
+    assert packed.rows.tolist() == [0, 1, 8, 9, 10]
+    assert packed.positions.tolist() == [0, 1, 0, 1, 2]
+    assert packed.cu_seqlens.tolist() == [0, 2, 5]
+

+def test_encoder_runs_only_the_valid_frames(tiny_tower):
+    encoder = tiny_tower.encoder.asr_encoder
+    device = encoder.final_norm.weight.device
+    torch.manual_seed(2)
+    x = torch.randn(3, 6, encoder.d_model, device=device)
+    lengths = torch.tensor([6, 0, 3])
+    with torch.inference_mode():
+        states, _ = encoder(
+            x, lengths.to(device), bypass_pre_encode=True, lengths_cpu=lengths
+        )
+        alone = [
+            encoder(
+                x[row : row + 1, :length],
+                lengths[row : row + 1].to(device),
+                bypass_pre_encode=True,
+            )[0][0]
+            for row, length in ((0, 6), (2, 3))
+        ]
+    assert not states[1].any()
+    assert not states[2, :, 3:].any()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(states[0], alone[0], rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-4)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(states[2, :, :3], alone[1], rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-4)
+
